title.en: Give Uniswap's Universal Router a Permit2 allowance for one token
title.zh-TW: 在 Permit2 授權 Uniswap Universal Router 使用一個代幣

summary.en: The Safe calls `approve` on Permit2 so that Universal Router 2.1.2 can pull the token you pick from the Safe through Permit2. The amount is 2^160-1 (Permit2's unlimited), and the app sets the expiry, usually 30 days. The router pulls tokens only from the address that calls it, so only the Safe's own later swaps can use it.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 呼叫 Permit2 的 `approve`，讓 Universal Router 2.1.2 能透過 Permit2 從 Safe 拉你選的代幣，數量 2^160-1（Permit2 的無上限），到期時間由 app 設，通常 30 天。router 只從呼叫它的地址拉代幣，所以只有 Safe 自己之後的兌換能用。

text.en: The allowance goes only to the router. The router pulls tokens only from the Safe that calls it, so while the allowance stays, only the Safe can use it.
text.zh-TW: 授權只給 router；router 只從呼叫它的 Safe 拉代幣，留著也只有 Safe 能用。

pastTxsConclusion.en: No Safe approval fits. EOA approvals mostly name router 0x66a9893cC07D91D95644AEDD05D03f95e1dBA8Af, not this one, or set another amount or 0; each gives MISMATCH.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 沒有 Safe 的授權符合。EOA 的授權多半給 router 0x66a9893cC07D91D95644AEDD05D03f95e1dBA8Af，不是這個，或設別的數量或 0；都會是 MISMATCH。

intro.en: Uniswap: the largest decentralized exchange on Ethereum. All v4 pools live in one PoolManager contract.
intro.zh-TW: Uniswap：以太坊上最大的去中心化交易所；v4 的池子都在同一個 PoolManager 合約裡。

text.en: The v4 core and periphery contracts and the Universal Router all have public audit reports (OpenZeppelin, Spearbit, Certora and others), in each repo's audits folder.
text.zh-TW: v4 核心與周邊合約、Universal Router 都有公開的審計報告（OpenZeppelin、Spearbit、Certora 等），放在各 repo 的 audits 資料夾。

text.en: Allowances that stay after the transaction: the Safe's unlimited allowance to Permit2, and the 2^160-1, 30-day allowance to the Universal Router inside Permit2. The router pulls tokens only from the address that calls it, so only the Safe's own later transactions can use it.
text.zh-TW: 交易後留著的授權：Safe 給 Permit2 的無上限授權，和 Permit2 裡給 Universal Router 的 2^160-1、30 天授權。router 只從呼叫它的地址拉代幣，所以只有 Safe 自己之後的交易能用它。

recommendation.en: Acceptable. To revoke, call approve(Permit2, 0) on the token, or call lockdown on Permit2.
recommendation.zh-TW: 可以接受；想收回時，對代幣呼叫 approve(Permit2, 0)，或在 Permit2 呼叫 lockdown。

text.en: Permit2 source (AllowanceTransfer): approve writes allowance[msg.sender][token][spender]; _transfer reads the allowance of its caller and reverts once it has expired; an amount of 2^160-1 is not reduced by use

text.en: The Uniswap trading API's spec: a request that pins no version defaults to 2.1.2 on chains where it is deployed; 2.2.0 is only for swaps of a permissioned token
text.zh-TW: Uniswap 交易 API 規格：沒指定版本時，在有部署的鏈上預設 2.1.2；2.2.0 只用於受許可代幣的兌換

text.en: Uniswap/interface code: the app pins no router version except 2.2.0 for a permissioned token, so it takes the API's default
text.zh-TW: Uniswap/interface 程式碼：除了受許可代幣指定 2.2.0，app 不指定 router 版本，所以用 API 的預設

text.en: Uniswap's notice: 2.1.2 from 2026-09-21; API requests that pin 2.0 or 2.1.1 get an error from 2026-10-21

Verified source on Sourcify: the Permit2 transfers in Dispatcher take msgSender() as payer, and a batch reverts when a from is not msgSender(); Lock sets that to the caller of execute. A search of contracts/ found no Ownable, onlyOwner, delegatecall or selfdestruct
text.zh-TW: Sourcify 的已驗證原始碼：Dispatcher 裡的 Permit2 轉帳以 msgSender() 當付款人，批次中 from 不是 msgSender() 就 revert；Lock 把它設成呼叫 execute 的地址。在 contracts/ 搜尋沒有 Ownable、onlyOwner、delegatecall 或 selfdestruct
